name: Transportation Sites
description:
This dataset catalogs transportation service sites, primarily schools and pre-K/EI locations, along with their addresses, geographic coordinates, and the transportation options available at each site. Each row represents a site for a given school year, identified by an option code and name, with details on affiliation (public, charter, yeshiva, parochial, and other types), site type (school, pre-K/EI site, or office), and full street address including city, state, and ZIP code. Latitude and longitude are provided for mapping.

Service fields indicate whether each site offers door-to-door transportation, stop-to-school service, common carrier Metrocards, site reimbursement, mid-day service, and door-to-door or stop-to-school late-day program transport. Most records fall in the 2016-2017 school year, with smaller shares from adjacent years, and sites are concentrated in New York City's five boroughs, with a small number in New Jersey and Connecticut.
